system.name: Agent backdoor attacks (Query-Attack, Observation-Attack, Thought-Attack)
system.one_liner: A study of backdoor threats to LLM-based agents, with three attack forms illustrated on a web-shopping task.

content.variant_note: four aligned lanes of the same Thought, Action, Observation, Output chain: a benign agent first, then the three attack forms, all on one shopping query; red marks where each attack acts
content.argues: Backdoors in LLM agents take three forms: a trigger in the query or in an observation steers the output; a thought-only attack changes the reasoning but not the answer.
content.subject: one web-shopping query run through a benign agent and three backdoored agents, each lane showing thought, search action, shop listing and purchase

encoding.color_means: avatar colour = which agent (orange benign, blue Query-Attack, green Observation-Attack, brown Thought-Attack); red text = the attacker's trigger or its injected effect; green text = optimal outcome; yellow-tinted action box = manipulated action, green tint = normal action; blue = arrows and product names
encoding.line_style_means: dark-red rectangle = the listing the agent picks; dashed rounded frame = key of the four agents
encoding.shape_means: box with a pointer tail = thought; tinted box plus search bar = action; window with traffic-light dots = observation; BUY tag = purchase
encoding.marker_means: three dots = omitted steps; size chips and colour swatches are product attributes
encoding.emphasis: red is the only strong colour on text, so the eye lands on where each attack acts
reusable_patterns: four aligned lanes of identical typed columns (Thought, Action, Observation, Output), one per attack form, under one shared query
red text only on the attacker's trigger and its effects, green text for the correct outcome
one avatar per variant, shown in a dashed key and again at the start of each lane
drawn browser windows as observations with the picked row boxed
outputs as a BUY tag, product name and a bracketed coloured verdict
tint of the action box changes (green normal, yellow manipulated)
weaknesses: dense 5-6.5 pt serif text inside the listings
the red box marks the picked listing in every lane, even the benign one, so red has two meanings (selection and attacker's mark)

lessons.what_to_learn: Run one concrete query through aligned lanes, one per variant, with identical typed columns so that the only differences are red-marked spans; reserve red for the attacker's trigger and effects and use a green verdict for the correct result.
lessons.suits: comparisons of attack, failure or intervention variants on a single agent trajectory with visible text at every step.

evidence: We choose a query from a web shopping [65] scenario as an example.
Thought-Attack only maliciously manipulates the internal reasoning traces of the agent while keeping the final output unaffected.
the attackers only introduce malicious intermediate reasoning process to the agent while keeping the final output unchanged

summary: The paper studies backdoor threats to LLM-based agents and Figure 1 illustrates three forms on a web-shopping query. A grey banner holds the query with the trigger word sneakers in red; a dashed key names four robot avatars (benign agent, Query-Attack, Observation-Attack, Thought-Attack). Four aligned lanes then run the same columns, Thought, Action, Observation, Output: thought boxes with text, search actions with Amazon or eBay search bars, drawn browser windows with product listings and a red box on the picked row, and BUY outputs whose bracketed verdicts are green for the optimal Puma sneaker and red for the attacker's Adidas choices.
summary_zh: 论文研究 LLM 智能体的后门攻击，图用一个网购查询演示三种形式。顶部是查询框和四个机器人图例，下方四条对齐的泳道依次是思考、动作、观察、输出，红色文字标出触发词和被操纵的步骤，输出的括号结论用绿色或红色区分。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The colour of the words in the last output line (Optimal Answer / By Calling Target API) could not be told with certainty: Optimal Answer is green, the API phrase appears to mark the malicious step. The orange to brown avatars may be stock clip-art or illustrated for the figure.
